method: Approximate manual head-root/shoulder joint midpoint and shoulder span versus already connected Nwalk. Waist-junction diagnostic is recorded but not used to normalize torso foreshortening. No bbox-height fitting. No image pixels changed.
limitations: Manual landmark positions are provisional; shoulder movement and running lean affect projection.
Head, shoulders and pelvis must be privately inspected together at compiled Player physical scale before accepting any virtual canvas.
Current source side identities are correct, but compression phases1/4 and projected flight2/5 require independent source-art verdict.
Support/flight translations and runtime anchors are deliberately unset. No automatic foot/bbox lock.
Initial common-key reference ratio3.25 was conditioning only; this document adds the existing good Nwalk absolute-size reference.
